about: The offline oracle: each row is one scripted scenario run by tests/run_sim.py against the real mod code with a mocked CET/game API and a box city. Passing here means the logic works, not that it works in the game.

rows.scenario: Start on a 40 m roof facing an avenue of 70-110 m towers, run off, hold Jump, let go on the up-swing (vertical speed > 2 m/s), hold again for a second swing, let go on its up-swing
rows.pass_if: two swings start; lowest point while swinging >= swing_floor_clearance - 1 above the street; travelled >= 80 m; peak speed >= 18 m/s; no driven frame faster than max_speed + 1; never inside a building

rows.scenario: Run off a 40 m roof, tap Jump, then press Crouch in the air (ToggleCrouch and Crouch both arrive)
rows.pass_if: sink rate never above glide_sink + 0.5; horizontal speed reaches 90% of glide_speed

rows.scenario: Stand in the street, aim 10 degrees up at a wall 50 m away, press Jump while aiming
rows.pass_if: body passes within 3 m of the aimed point; never inside a building; no fall damage

rows.scenario: The two-swing run from t_swing_from_roof, then fall to the street
rows.pass_if: hand-back happens with the feet <= ground_probe above ground and vertical speed handed to the game is 0
no swing starts (normal jump left to the game)

rows.scenario: The two-swing run three times: action polling only (OnAction names unreadable, as Melty reports for CET 1.37.1), OnAction only (polling unavailable), and both at once
rows.pass_if: two swings start on every route; with both routes, each press is handled exactly once

rows.scenario: The two-swing run with the camera's basis turned 90 degrees about Z (as Melty saw on some game versions), both directions
rows.pass_if: two swings start and travel >= 80 m forward along the player's heading in both cases
